claims.sourceText: Department of War FOIA appellate decision, December 2025
claims.text: On 15 December 2025 a FOIA appellate decision remanded the case to the Department for additional searches, granting the appeal that argued a search limited to the Correspondence Management Division was inadequate under Oglesby v. U.S. Dep't of Army, 920 F.2d 57 (D.C. Cir. 1990).

title: Department of War FOIA appellate decision, December 2025

topics.title: Perception management: YANKEE BLUE, psychological operations and disinformation practice
